changes.summary: Signed-out visits are counted now — Owner Activity shows how much of the traffic comes from people who never sign in, and which public pages they read.
Players on injured reserve no longer count against your active roster when you add a free agent — the form now shows how many active spots you actually have.
The game line on Set Lineup now leads with the network's logo at text size and closes on a bigger opponent helmet — the channel was reading as the headline.
Live Scoring showed no fantasy matchups during the Wednesday opener — the board now loads its scores directly and keeps polling on any game night.
Owner Activity no longer slides sideways on a phone — the Last Seen table scrolls on its own now, instead of dragging the page with it.
The Team Assets gallery no longer slides sideways on a phone — team cards fit the screen now instead of holding a 420px column open.
League Comparison and the Design System no longer side-scroll on a phone — the points table and the keyframe blocks scroll on their own.
